newsitem.title: CHINA: IBM to buy 50 pct more parts from China.
newsitem.headline: IBM to buy 50 pct more parts from China.

text.p: U.S. computer giant International Business Machines (IBM) plans to purchase $300 million worth of computer parts from China in 1996, 50 percent more than in 1995, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.

More than 80 percent of the computer parts would be bought from China's southern Guangdong province, where the computer manufacturing industry had developed rapidly in recent years, it quoted an IBM official as saying.
IBM had set up a purchasing centre in the Shenzhen Special Economic Zone in Guangdong province, he said.
The move would lower IBM's production costs and promote the development of the Chinese computer industry, he said.
IBM now has six joint ventures in China, three of which are in Shenzhen, Xinhua said.
